Profile

Professional Profile

Applied Electrical Engineering graduate in Electrical Power Systems from State Polytechnic of Malang. My academic and industrial experience includes electrical maintenance, preventive maintenance of production equipment, power-system analysis, and technical reporting. My internship at PT Tirta Sukses Perkasa focused on evaluating preventive maintenance of the extruder machine electrical system in cup production. My final thesis examines the performance of a capacitor bank control system in supporting power stability. I graduated with a CGPA of 3.69, hold a TOEIC score of 630, and am certified as a Low-Voltage Utilization Maintenance Group Leader.

Projects focused on electrical system performance.

Final Thesis · 2026 · PT Tirta Sukses Perkasa

Performance Analysis of a Capacitor Bank Control System in Maintaining Power Stability

This thesis analyzes the performance of a capacitor bank control system and its role in supporting power stability at PT Tirta Sukses Perkasa.

  • Review of capacitor bank control and reactive power compensation.
  • Evaluation of the system's role in maintaining power-system performance.
  • Technical analysis supported by thesis documentation.
  • Industrial context based on the PT Tirta Sukses Perkasa site.
